Title: Greek Lemon Chicken & Potatoes + Honey Balsamic Roasted Carrots (Hungry Happens + KaleforniaKravings)

Items: 0.61 kg potatoes (Yukon Gold), peeled and cut into quarters
2 medium red onions, cut into thick wedges
Juice of about 1 1/3 lemons (practical: 1 large + 1 small, or 2 small)
1/3 tsp paprika (plus extra to sprinkle on top, optional)
450 g carrots, cut into ~4 cm chunks (halve lengthways if thick)
15 ml oil (avocado oil or olive oil)
30 ml balsamic vinegar, divided (15 ml + 15 ml)

Instructions: T-15 (Prep starts) — Chicken + potatoes + onion: Pat dry 0.91 kg chicken thighs. Peel and quarter 0.61 kg potatoes. Cut 2 medium red onions into thick wedges. In a large bowl combine 118 ml olive oil, lemon juice (about 1 1/3 lemons), 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, 3/4 tsp thyme, 1/3 tsp chilli flakes, 1/3 tsp paprika, 1 2/3 tsp salt, and 1/3 tsp black pepper. Toss chicken, potatoes, and red onion until coated. Tip into a roasting dish with chicken pieces touching the bottom. Cover tightly with parchment then foil.

T-15 (Prep continues) — Carrots: In a bowl whisk 15 ml oil + 15 ml balsamic vinegar + 15 ml honey + 2 minced garlic cloves + 1 tsp thyme + 1/4 tsp salt + pepper. Toss 450 g carrots to coat. Lift carrots onto a lined tray and keep the leftover bowl liquid (for brushing later).
T+0 — Put covered chicken + potatoes + onion into the oven at 210°C fan. Set timer for 45 minutes.

T+45 — Remove foil + parchment (leave chicken/potatoes/onion uncovered). Turn oven down to 200°C fan. Return chicken/potatoes/onion for 15 minutes total (T+45 to T+60). Put the carrots tray in at the same time. Set timer for 10 minutes (next step T+55).
T+55 — Brush/stir carrots with the reserved bowl liquid. Return carrots to the oven and set timer for 5 minutes (next check T+60).
T+60 — Check chicken/potatoes/onion. If chicken is browned and cooked through, remove the dish and rest on the counter. Leave carrots in the oven and set timer for 5 minutes (next step T+65).
T+65 — Remove carrots (extend only if clearly still firm). Mix 15 ml balsamic vinegar + 15 ml honey and drizzle over carrots, then toss to coat. Top with goat cheese (optional).
T+70 — Serve: Rested chicken/potatoes/onion should have had about 10 minutes. Spoon pan juices over when plating. Serve with lemon wedges and squeeze over to taste.
